name: ceramics-storefront
description: The customer-facing storefront: lets shoppers browse and search the catalog, manage a cart, check out as a guest or signed-in customer, and view their past orders when signed in. Does not manage the product catalog or order fulfillment — that is the admin app's job.

dependencies.name: ceramics-api
dependencies.description: Fetches the product catalog, manages the shopper's cart, submits checkout, and (when signed in) fetches order history.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Optional shopper sign-in via Thunder SSO to retain order history; guest checkout does not require it.
